name: Opening Rows
description: A list of compact rows where choosing one opens it in place into a full dialog card, and closing folds it back.

props.name: items
props.type: { id: string; title: string; subtitle: string; src: string; content: ReactNode; action?: ReactNode }[]
props.description: The rows. content is the body of the open card; action is its main button, placed at the bottom right.

props.name: layout
props.description: Compact rows with a thumbnail, or tiles with the image on top. The grid follows its container's width.

props.name: viewLabel
props.description: Label of the button on each row. Its accessible name adds the row's title.

props.name: closeLabel
props.description: Accessible label for the close button on the open card.

props.name: backdropBlur
props.description: Blurs the page behind the scrim. Off by default: the browser redraws the blur on every frame while anything behind it changes, which stalls on large pages, most of all in Firefox.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes for the outer element, which is a size container.
